notes.title: Hotfix - 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Hello sailors,

I've listened to your feedback, and in this small patch, achievements have been adjusted to more achievable levels. When you choose to continue the game from where you left off, the system will check all achievements and award the ones you've earned.

The changed achievements are listed below:

IntermediateBuilder --------- : 50 -> 5
ExpertBuilder ---------------- : 100 -> 10
IntermediateThief ------------ : 10 -> 3
ExpertThief ------------------ : 100 -> 5
IntermediateSharkHunter ---- : 10 -> 5
ExpertSharkHunter ---------- : 100 -> 10
IntermediateFishHunter ----- : 100 -> 50
ExpertFishHunter ------------ : 1000 -> 100
ExpertSurvivor -------------- : 100 -> 30
ExpertMerchant ------------- : 10000 -> 5000
FairPlay ---------------------- : Anyone -> Any Villiagers

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.2.2
notes.notes:
- When landing on an enemy ship, we couldn't always withdraw the crew at the desired time. Now, two actions are assigned to two different buttons. This allows both actions to be performed in any situation.

- A docking maneuver has been added when sending crew to land on an enemy ship. This ensures that ships moving away from the waves will remain close.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.2.1
notes.notes:
The reward for the first part of the Old Man's Revenge mission has been increased to 500 gold. This has accelerated the next mission.

 When the Ship Upgrades and Mission List screens were open, the description panels next to the cursor would sometimes appear off-screen. They now work properly on all screen resolutions.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.2.0
notes.notes: - Fixed the issue where [spoiler]the Monster Shark on the sunken island would swim in endless circles around the poisoned bait[/spoiler] instead of eating it.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.9
notes.notes:
The total gold amount for merchant achievements now counts towards achievements. 

The shark in the sunken city now turns more sharply, eliminating the risk of wet bait. 

The information for the key you need to hold down to surrender was missing from the screen. This has been fixed.

The "Expert Thief" achievement has been removed due to the impossibility of stealing 100 times.

Fishing now allows you to catch 1 to 3 fish at a time, rather than just one. This allows for more efficient use of fishing time.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.8
notes.notes: - Your achievements that are missing while the player is offline or due to reasons originating from Steam will now be checked every time you start the game and all inactive earned achievements will be completed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.5
notes.notes:
- Added DX12 Support
- Added fall animation for felled trees
- Sometimes we were not able to get items from the last hits on trees, this has been fixed.

- Fixed missing characters in Korean, Japanese, and Chinese

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Fixed the last ability not being unlocked after the game was completed due to missing skill points.
Fixed the compass in the Mystery Target section pointing to the wrong location.
The Ship merchant in the Lost City now also trades silk fabric and iron.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.1
notes.notes:
The camera was still rotating slowly even at maximum speed. This has been fixed.

The maximum value in Camera Settings > Camera Sensitivity is now 50 instead of 20. It is increasing by 5 increments.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.1.0
notes.notes: When we recruited crew, the new crew would die instantly, this has been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0.9
notes.notes:
-Enemies with pistols can shoot though walls, fixed.
-The female pianist has a male voice, fixed.
-Upgrading broadsides for more guns and damage proves to be detrimental, because enemy ships always sink before they can be boarded, fixed.
-When boarding, your crew can get stuck on the side of your ship, and stays there after boarding, fixed.
-Ammunition has the picture of modern assault rifle-bullets, changed.
-Sharks are turned off, but they're still there, fixed.
-You can upgrade ranged damage of your crew, but they never use guns, fixed. (Turned into crew health power)
-All achievements are now unlockable and I've added a system to check for missing achievements.

notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0.7
notes.notes:
When we finished the last mission, the game would crash if we were on a ship. This has been fixed.
Landing on ships has been made more stable.
When we called our crew back and bombed the enemy ship, our crew was also lost. This has been fixed.
We could also injure our own crew on the enemy ship. This has been fixed.
On our level 2 ship, the crew was destroyed while using our last ability permanently, but they were rescued.
While cursed, we were initially blinded. This has been fixed.
Calculations on low display settings were displayed halfway on the screen. This has been fixed.
The game crashed when the captain in the last mission was captured. He has been repaired, and now he cannot be captured again.

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Full Release – Set Sail Into the Complete Pirate Adventure!
notes.notes:
Ahoy adventurers!The wait is over — Captain Bones has officially launched as a full game!
 Thanks to your ongoing support and feedback, we’ve reached a major milestone, delivering a complete experience with even more to come.


🧭 Key Features:

✅ Complete Story Mode
 Captain Bones’ tale is now fully playable from beginning to end. It’s time to finish what you started and uncover the untold pirate curse.

🚢 New Warship with 6 Crew

 Introducing a powerful new ship to command! Bigger and stronger, this vessel brings more tactical options for sea battles.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/696fa276e0ee8fa41bbe394600d625382821c433.png"]

🕸️ The Hidden Dungeon Area
 Explore the dungeon zone filled with danger, mystery. Only the brave will survive.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/b3673830168f87a11a24d307809bec7b18119280.png"]



🔧 Smarter Item Mechanics
 Activities like chopping trees, repairing, and lighting fires now require you to have the correct item in your quick-access inventory.
 More logic, more immersion!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/becdd7d155fa4298e2b1f414a37aecfde0448617.png"]
🚀 What’s Coming Next?
But the journey doesn’t end here.
 Coming soon:

Enhanced mechanics 

Secret updates and surprises 

With the strength of our community, Captain Bones will keep evolving!


[hr][/hr]

⚓ Take the Wheel, Captain!
Adventure, challenge, and discovery await in the full version of Captain Bones.
 The story may be complete — but the legend is just beginning.







[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png"]

notes.title: Major Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings Fearless Sailors,

Today I'm here with a general bug cleanup package focusing on all known bugs.

I've cleaned all the bugs on my list, both the ones you've sent me and the ones I've noticed.

If you see any bugs that I have forgotten to resolve, or any ongoing bugs that remain unresolved, please leave a comment on this post. I will solve them as soon as possible.

Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/13144d6417cbe355cd973a8ac4361e166d4f8fa9.png

 From now on, you can use the cooking stove to save the game at any time without lighting a fire.
 Now, to drop an object from our inventory, just drag and drop it. Previously, we had to hold an object in our hand before we could drop it.
 Increased base speed of all ships in the game.
 From now on, the map automatically focuses on the player every time it opens, whereas before it opened from where it was last left, making it time-consuming to find ourselves.
 Fixed the player going above the water when looting underwater and making unnecessary rotations.
 When we got the ability to turn into a skeleton and play dead, there was no helpful text on how to do it.



Resolved Bugs & Issiues

 Merchant ships were prevented from passing through the islands to avoid us.
 NPC characters could hold the ball with a sword in their hand. Some of them were also unable to hold the fishing rod.
 Prevented from cutting our own crew when we landed on an enemy ship. But in hard and impossible mode, our sword still cuts our own men.
 Fixed incorrect message when firing ship cannons while reloading.
 When we put an item in our ship's inventory and then pick it up again, its lifespan was reset, now its lifespan is unchanged.
 The crabs are no longer extinct, they reappear periodically.
 On a level 2 ship, the number of crew members could be increased without buying cannons.


Since I have reached a stable version in the game, the next package will focus on game improvements from you.

After that, I will roll up my sleeves for the continuation of the story.

Thank you very much for your support and understanding in my 7-year adventure.

Have fun all.

notes.title: New Story Update - Part 2/2
notes.notes:
Hello Sailors!

Today the rest of the story of the ending was released! A new puzzle awaits you in this episode. In the next chapters, these puzzles and treasures will be even more complicated and ship battles will begin again!

Some important bugs have also been fixed (there will be another update where I will focus on bugs in general)

Resolved Errors

 Even when we killed a crab, it could damage the player.
 Captains of merchant ships stayed away from the rudder.
 The camera angle was broken for some players after the curse cinematic.


New Additions

 By popular demand, the camera side can now be changed in the settings. The default is left, but now you can move it to the right side.
 Improved UI navigation in a few missions, making it easier for new players to find their way through them.
 Many of you have complained about sharks, now you can turn them off in the gameplay settings, just like snakes.

notes.title: Patch 0.5581
notes.notes:
Improvements

 Now, we have full control of movement when attacking with a sword.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/d2d2e9a43485c3db0a9d7382c67e3537739df23e.gif

 The player can now walk while aiming with a spear. So, we are able to dodge coming enemy attacks while aiming.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/b4830d81a3a95668262b4d8d83c27a5148d35efe.gif


Bug Fixes

 If the player got too close to an enemy ship while swimming, the enemy ship would shoot itself.
 There were no colliders in the soldiers' green tent on Sunken Reef island.
 There was a UI issue within the gamepad settings panel.
 From now on players can not sell or drop quest items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Patch 0.5580
notes.notes:
New Features

 Captain Bones is now able to block enemy sword attacks but timing is important.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/29d0ff84c5c2515cef0cf4382846f69fb7e1e981.gif

 The player can now run while eating or drinking now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/d36ad5338f9ba7d9aca23350a0793cf18f955282.gif


Improvements

 All stackable item limits are now 99.
 From now on, Captain Bones is able to fish anywhere including from our ship.
 Eating food doesn't increase thirst anymore.
 Disabling Anti-Aliasing is now available in the settings menu.
 There is no longer a need to constantly press the button to focus on the enemy while fighting with swords. The press and release feature can be activated in the game settings.


Bug Fixes

 The player can not continue fishing after falling into the ocean is fixed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Patch 0.5579
notes.notes:
New Features

 Sub filter buttons added to Crafting Panel. Now on, we can filter craft items by types like food or weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/109dbe33f915037d7e6673fc996d9856b7635442.gif

Improvements

 Boarding the enemy ship now has two stages. One, we dock to ship as usual. Then, we should give a second order to our crew for boarding the enemy ship.
 Player melee combat lock distance increased. So, we can continue to keep focus when we dodge back.
 The Player's some of sword attacks animation is changed. We can hit the enemy's body easier.
 Almost all crafting times were decreased. Now, we can craft faster.
 Ship wheel and shipwreck's location were changed. So, new players won't have to go and return back between the same locations 3 times.
 The speed of climbing animations was increased.
 Player main capsule height is decreased a bit, so we will be able to enter smaller areas now.
 Auto heath restores when the player is about to die, are only enabled for easy and normal mode players now.
 Now on, enemy soldiers can't hurt us while we are already attacking if we are playing on Easy game mode.
 Also, enemy soldiers can't hurt us while we are rolling or doing dodge if we are playing on Normal game mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9d488daa6c90cb6b1764bebc379ce73e849fe063.gif

Bug Fixes

 Now on, there is no penalty when our ship sunk. The game won't auto-saving to dock anymore. It will load only previous saved data.
 When you changed the gender of the player and reload the game, the player doesn't return back the previous gender anymore.
 Our mast doesn't keep locked when it is in an invisible state anymore.
 Some quest help mechanics were kept working when the game mode was hard or impossible, but they no longer work.
 The ambiance and game sound are not mute when we pause the game issue is fixed.
 Sometimes we can die because of hunger when we are drunk, now we wake up.
 Fixed the issue where sometimes the trajectory of the cannon would not be visible when aiming while driving our ship.

notes.title: Patch 0.5577
notes.notes:
New Features

 Game Mode Section is now available, you choose between Easy, Normal, Hard, and Impossible
 The game will be automatically saved when you stop holding the ship wheel if you changed the zone.


Improvements

 The player's sword swing speed has been increased.
 Increased the range of the cave bazaar indicator
 Now Wanted is a time-based situation, there are 4 levels of want. Each one is 5 minutes long.


Bug Fixes

 Our crew was attacking the next ship without orders after the battle.
 Sometimes the player would fall from the ship's deck while the player was holding the ship's cannon.
 When throwing a spear or falling into the water, the buoyancy of the water was not working.

notes.title: Major Update - New Features And More
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I want to tell you about the new features added to the game.

Fishing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/722a723c9cb470c2d3f52dd8ef068666ae220ae1.gif
Now we can fish from the beach, pier or raft. If you don't pull on the rope when the fish hits the hook, the fish will run away. When you fish, there are less fish in the sea.

Trading
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/f97206ec9ea3164789d48f4e44130132d7d08b3b.gif
The game also has an economy system. You can sell your crafted or collected items to merchants. Or buy something cool from them. You should also consider that they will lower the price if they buy too much.

Sailing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/0c0e765b11830761939dc309c90975aba4377f12.gif
Open world sailing is the main mechanic of the game. Because of this, we need to consider the direction of the wind in order to move the raft. Now we need to rotate the sails to get the power to move.

Unlocking Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/d6c574be5548216bc83043a814362afa8803b616.gif
As a pirate, we should already have unlocking skills. You also need to have strong reflexes. Because to unlock, you have to stop the icons when they get close to each other.

Map & Compass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/e9101cabe6a1882c37689b7fc5a2d8502086e868.gif
There will be many islands when the game is published. So, we will need to find our way using the map and compass. We can also put a mark on the map so as not to forget our destination.

Skill Tree
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/5238a38a37ae6fcd839e1c35724e874d909f50ed.gif
In addition, we will need to improve ourselves in order to deal with the curse we have. I don't want to give any more spoiler.

And there are a lot of minor improvements that I haven't mentioned here. I'm working on the game 18 hours a day. So, I'm trying my best to complete the game as soon as possible.

Thank you so much for your all supports! Don't forget to join our Discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35769272/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png
